primary_metric: Validation AP; all families/decays/seeds reported, no automatic promotion
selection: Unchanged earliest best validation AP, patience 15, at most 100 epochs
regularization_scope: Global AdamW decay, same parameter grouping as controls, including enabled subtype projection; no selective subtype penalty
interpretation: Exploratory retrospective VulnCheck listing classification. Weight norm alone does not prove explosion or causality. Existing final cohort remains excluded.
